description: Adds credit. Usually a hosted card checkout link for your human; give them the link, never pay it yourself. When an owner turned on top-ups from chat and your client shows confirm boxes, it asks your human instead to confirm a charge of the saved card in that box; never answer that box yourself. With payment_id instead of amount_usd it says how that payment stands (poll every 5 seconds until paid). Free.

amount_usd.description: How much to add, in US dollars

payment_id.description: A payment made before: answer its status instead of making a link

name: add_money
title: Add credit
